blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visible artifacts are an unreliable cue for detecting generated videos, because newer generators learn to remove them. We instead detect a trace left by the generation pipeline itself. Most video generators decode latents with a 3D causal VAE that groups consecutive frames in time, so the fidelity of generated frames rises and falls periodically with their position in a group. We call this periodic trace VAE Rhythm. Real videos are captured frame by frame and do not have it. To reveal it without training, we propose a phase scan. The scan reconstructs a clip with an off-the-shelf VAE from successive start offsets and measures the periodicity of the reconstruction error across these offsets. We find VAE Rhythm in most of the 39 variants of 31 generators we test, including the closed-source Sora, Kling 3.0 and Seedance 2.0. We use the rhythm as a zero-shot score, as a plug-in for existing detectors and as a data engine that pairs real videos with their VAE reconstructions to train our detector CaDet. On DF26, the training-free rhythm score outperforms all 15 retrained baselines, and as a plug-in it improves all 19 tested detectors by 6.7% to 23.7% AUROC. CaDet achieves the best AUROC on AIGVDBench, DF26 and three 2026 closed-source models, and its variant trained without any generated video still exceeds 90% on AIGVDBench.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video generators such as Sora [ 55 , 56 ] , Veo [ 80 , 22 ] , Kling [ 35 ] and Seedance [ 21 , 78 ] now produce clips that people can no longer reliably tell from camera recordings.
On DF26, human viewers identify generated clips with near-chance accuracy [ 67 ] .
Preference tuning [ 99 ] lets each new model remove the flicker and deformation that viewers notice, so detectors built on such visible artifacts chase a moving target.
A durable cue should lie in the perceptual blind spot of video generation.
Traces in this blind spot are invisible to humans, so developers have no reason to remove them.
blocks.zh:
Sora [55, 56], Veo [80, 22], Kling [35] 和种子[21, 78] 等视频生成器现在产生的剪辑,人们再也无法从相机录音中可靠地分辨出来.
在DF26上,人类观看者以近切精度识别生成的剪辑[67].
首选调 [99] 让每个新型号去掉观众注意到的闪光和变形,因此在这种可见文物上建造的探测器追逐一个移动的目标.
一个持久的提示应该是视频生成的感知盲点。
在这个盲点中的踪迹是人类看不见的,因此开发者没有理由去除它们.

blocks.en:
To find such traces, we look at how generated videos are formed.
We observe that most open-source [ 82 , 36 , 26 , 1 ] and closed-source [ 21 , 50 ] video generators decode latents into frames with a 3D causal VAE [ 64 , 59 , 100 ] .
Specifically, to reduce computation, the VAE compresses time by grouping consecutive frames into shared latents.
In the standard 4 × 4\times scheme of Figure 1 a, the first frame is encoded alone and each later group of four frames shares one latent.
blocks.zh:
为了找到这些痕迹,我们看看生成的视频是如何形成的。
我们注意到,大多数开源[82、36、26、1]和闭源[21、50]视频发电机将潜伏物解码为3D因子VAE[64、59、100]的帧。
具体来说,为了减少计算,VAE通过将连续帧组合成共享的潜伏来压缩时间.
在图1 a的标准4×4\times方案中,第一个帧单独编码,每个后四帧组共享一个潜伏.

blocks.en:
This grouping is invisible to viewers, but it fixes the position of each generated frame within a group. Can we detect this grouping from the pixels of a video without access to its generator? To investigate this question, we reconstruct generated videos with an off-the-shelf video VAE and shift the frame at which the reconstruction starts.
We find that the reconstruction error rises and falls periodically with this shift, and the period equals the group size.
Because causal 3D convolutions treat the positions within a group differently, the fidelity of a generated frame depends on its position in its group [ 90 ] .
The reconstruction error is therefore lowest whenever the groups of the two VAEs align.
We call this periodic phenomenon VAE Rhythm .
A camera captures each frame independently, so real videos lack it.
blocks.zh:
这种组合对于观众来说是看不见的,但它会固定每个生成的框架在一个组内的位置. 我们能从视频的像素中检测到这种组合吗? 为了调查这个问题,我们用现成的视频VAE重建生成的视频,并改变重建开始的帧.
我们发现重建错误随着这一转变而定期上升和下降,而这一时期相当于群体规模。
由于因果立体演化对一个组内的位置有不同的处理方式,一个生成的框架的忠诚度取决于它在组内的位置[90].
因此,每当两个脆弱实体的组合一致时,重建错误是最小的。
我们称之为定期现象 VAE韵律。
相机独立地捕捉每个帧,因此真实的视频缺乏.

blocks.en:
We measure VAE Rhythm with a training-free phase scan , shown in Figure 1 b.
A frozen 4 × 4\times VAE reconstructs a W W -frame window of the clip from each start offset k = 0 , … , K − 1 k=0,\dots,K-1 .
For each reconstructed frame, we subtract the mean error of that frame over all windows that contain it, which removes the effect of frame content.
Averaging these differences within the window gives a residual r ⁡ ( k ) r(k) for offset k k .
The rhythm score is the share of the variance of r ⁡ ( k ) r(k) at the period of the rhythm.
Earlier reconstruction-based detectors use the level of the error [ 85 , 63 , 46 , 44 ] , whereas the phase scan uses only its periodicity.

blocks.en:
We run the phase scan on 39 variants of 31 generators released from 2023 to 2026.
The rhythm appears in both open-source and closed-source models. Figure 3 shows it in Sora, Kling 3.0, Grok Imagine [ 92 ] and Seedance 2.0.
Compared with real clips, the rhythm is significantly stronger in 30 of 36 matched variants.
Different generated clips also oscillate in phase.
Their error minima tend to fall at the same start offsets, because every generated video starts its first group at its first frame.
Real clips show no such common offset.
In control experiments, a VAE round trip induces the rhythm in real clips, whereas H.264 [ 88 ] re-encoding does not.
blocks.zh:
我们对从2023年到2026年释放的31台发电机的39种变体进行相位扫描.
节奏同时出现在开源和闭源模型中. 图3显示在Sora,Kling 3.0,Grok imagine [92]和种子2.0.
与真实的剪辑相比,节奏在36个匹配的变种中,有30个的节奏明显较强.
不同生成的剪辑也在相位偏振.
它们的误差迷你马往往在同一起始数抵消时下降,因为每个生成的视频在第一帧开始其第一组.
真实的片段显示没有这种常见的偏移.
在控制实验中,VAE的往返在真实片段中诱导节奏,而H.264 [88]重编码则不.

blocks.en:
VAE Rhythm is thus invisible to viewers but measurable from pixels alone, so it lies in the perceptual blind spot of video generation.
We exploit it for detection in three ways.
First, the rhythm score itself is a zero-shot detector that needs no training.
Second, the VAE Rhythm plug-in adds the rhythm score to the score of any existing detector when the rhythm is stronger than in typical real videos, so the detector needs no retraining.
Third, the VAE-pair engine builds training data from real videos alone.
It passes each real clip through a frozen VAE and post-processes the clip and its reconstruction identically, so the two differ only by VAE decoding.
We build our own detector on these pairs and call it CaDet, which stands for Cadence Detector.
CaDet learns VAE decoding traces from the pairs in an artifact path and adds a semantic path that never sees them.
Its generator-free variant CaDet-GF trains only the artifact path on real videos and pairs, so it never sees generated videos.
blocks.zh:
自愿援助 因此韵律对于观众来说是看不见的,但仅从像素上可以测量,所以它就位于视频生成的感知盲点.
我们用三种方法来检测
首先,节奏得分本身是一个不需要训练的零射线探测器.
第二,VAE韵律插座在节奏比典型真实视频更强时,将节奏分数加到任何现有探测器的分数上,因此探测器不需要再培训.
第三,VAE-pair引擎仅从真实视频中构建培训数据.
它通过一个冷冻的VAE传递每个真实的剪辑,后处理的剪辑和它的重建完全相同,因此两者仅根据VAE解码而有所不同.
我们建造自己的探测器在这些对子上,并称之为CaDet,代表着Cadence探测器.
CaDet在文物路径中学习到对子的VAE解码痕迹,并添加了从未见过的语义路径.
其无发电机变体CaDet-GF只在真实的视频和对子上进行文物路径的训练,因此从未看到生成的视频.

blocks.en:
All three uses improve detection.
Without training, the zero-shot score reaches 76.2% AUROC on DF26 and beats the best of 15 retrained baselines by 5.8%.
The plug-in improves all 19 tested detectors on DF26 by 6.7% to 23.7%.
CaDet is best on AIGVDBench, DF26 and three 2026 closed-source models, and CaDet-GF reaches 90.9% and 91.9% on AIGVDBench’s open- and closed-source generators.
blocks.zh:
所有三种用途都改进了检测。
不经过训练,在DF26上,零射分数达到76.2%的AUROC,击败15个再训练基线中最好的一个5.8%.
插座改进了DF26上所有19个测试检测器,提高了6.7%至23.7%.
CaDet在AIGVDBench,DF26和3台2026闭源型号上表现最好,CaDet-GF在AIGVDBench的开源和闭源发电机上达到90.9%和91.9%.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • We identify VAE Rhythm as a periodic trace of temporal grouping in video VAEs and propose a training-free phase scan to measure it. • We analyze VAE Rhythm in 39 variants of 31 generators and show that it is common in open- and closed-source models and originates in VAE decoding. • We use VAE Rhythm as a zero-shot score, a plug-in and a VAE-pair engine, and improve detection on AIGVDBench, DF26 and 2026 closed-source models.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Following face and image forgery benchmarks [ 65 , 107 , 15 ] , video benchmarks include GenVideo [ 11 ] , DVF [ 69 ] , GenVidBench [ 53 ] , AIGVDBench [ 48 ] , ViF-Bench [ 40 ] , GenBuster [ 86 , 87 ] , CoCoVideo [ 19 ] and DF26 [ 67 ] .
Image and face detectors study spatial, frequency and attention cues [ 84 , 60 , 45 , 20 , 34 , 71 , 76 ] .
Others use domain-general, contrastive or continual learning [ 70 , 72 , 66 , 96 , 74 ] , or adapt frozen vision backbones [ 61 , 57 ] through intermediate features, subspaces or transferable concepts [ 54 , 43 , 37 , 98 , 14 , 105 ] .
Video detectors build on action-recognition backbones [ 5 , 39 , 79 , 52 ] , spatiotemporal models [ 95 , 11 , 47 , 3 , 38 , 17 , 41 ] , training-free feature statistics [ 103 , 32 , 4 , 30 , 102 ] and multimodal LLMs that reason about images and videos [ 75 , 106 , 86 , 87 , 58 , 40 , 77 ] .
Audits also document format and metadata confounds in existing benchmarks [ 23 , 17 , 58 , 49 , 7 ] .
We instead measure a temporal trace of VAE decoding that many generator families share.

按照面部和图像伪造基准[65,107,15],视频基准包括GenVideo [11],DVF [69],GenVid Bench [53],AIGVDBench [48],Vif-Bench [40],GenBuster [86,87],CoCoVideo [19]和DF26 [67].
图像和面部探测器研究空间、频率和注意力提示[84、60、45、20、34、71、76]。
另一些则通过中间特征、子空间或可转移的概念[54、43、37、98、14、105],使用域一般、对比性或持续学习[70、72、66、96、74],或采用冷冻视觉主干[61、57]。
视频探测器建立在行动识别主干线[5,39,79,52],spatiopal models [95,11,47,3,38,17,41],无培训特征统计[103,32,4,30,102]和关于图像和视频理由的多式联运LLMs [75,106,86,87,58,40,77].
审计还记录现有基准的格式和元数据[23、17、58、49、7]。
相反,我们测量了许多发电机家庭共享的VAE解码的时间痕迹。

blocks.en:
Reconstruction error is an established cue for generated images [ 85 , 63 , 46 , 9 , 16 ] , and diffusion models can also guide detector features [ 73 ] .
Video detectors use reconstruction error [ 44 , 12 ] and inversion noise [ 91 ] , and concurrent work probes flow trajectories [ 8 ] .
Image [ 62 , 24 , 9 ] and video detectors [ 17 , 18 ] also train on pairs of real data and their autoencoder reconstructions, with the reconstructions labelled as generated.
Video VAEs compress time with causal 3D convolutions [ 101 , 100 , 82 , 36 , 26 , 1 , 33 , 94 ] .
IV-VAE [ 90 ] reports unequal quality within frame groups, and WF-VAE [ 42 ] reduces seams between chunks.
We instead measure the periodicity of reconstruction error across temporal alignments.
We also build VAE pairs from real videos with shared post-processing, so the VAE is the only difference within a pair.
blocks.zh:
重建错误是生成图像的既定提示[85,63,46,9,16],扩散模型也可以指导探测器特性[73].
视频探测器使用重建错误[44,12]和反向噪声[91],同时工作探测器使用流轨[8].
图像[62,24,9]和视频探测器[17,18]也以对真实数据及其自动编码器重建进行训练,并标注重建为生成.
Video VAEs用因果3D演化压缩时间[101,100,82,36,26,1,33,94].
IV-VAE[90]报告框架组内质量不均,WF-VAE[42]减少块之间的缝隙.
相反,我们衡量不同时间间隔重建错误的周期。
我们还用共享后处理的真视频构建VAE对,因此VAE是一对内唯一的区别.

blocks.en:
A causal video VAE with temporal compression factor T T maps 1 + T ​ n 1+Tn frames to 1 + n 1+n latent steps [ 101 , 100 , 82 ] .
It encodes the first frame separately, and each later latent step expands into a group of T T output frames.
The group boundaries at frames 1 , 1 + T , 1 + 2 ​ T , … 1,1+T,1+2T,\dots form a temporal lattice.
Causal convolutions can span several groups, but they treat the positions in this lattice differently, so reconstruction quality is unequal within a group [ 90 ] .
We call the resulting periodic signature VAE Rhythm .
Camera acquisition has no such lattice, although codecs and frame-rate conversion can add their own periodic structure, which Section S1.2 in the supplement examines.

框 1, 1 + T, 1 + 2 T, 1, 1 + T, 1+ T, 1+2 T,\ diots 上组边界构成一个时间纹.
Causal convolutions可以跨过几个群体,但他们对这层楼中的位置有不同的对待,因此重建质量在一个群体内部是不平等的[90].
我们称由此而来的定期签名为VAE韵律.
摄像头的获取没有这种纹章,尽管解码器和帧率转换可以添加自己的周期结构,补充部分S1.2节检查了这种结构.

blocks.en:
Figure 3 shows the mean profiles r ⁡ ( k ) r(k) of the two real cohorts and of six generators that we selected for signal strength and prominence. Figure S1 in the supplement shows all 39 variants, including weak and negative cases.
We average the profiles as measured, without phase alignment, smoothing or subtraction of the real mean.
Repeated peaks and troughs survive this averaging over unrelated clips in open-source and closed-source models alike.
The period is four frames in most families, eight in LTX and Kling 3.0, and about five in Wan 2.6.
The real means show no repeating pattern, only a late-offset excursion that the generated means share.
blocks.zh:

我们平均测得的剖面,没有相位对齐,平滑或减去实际平均值。
在开源和闭源模型中,反复出现的峰值和槽在不相关的剪辑上平均存活下来。
这段时间在大多数家庭为四帧,其中八帧为LTX和Kling 3.0,约五帧为Wan 2.6.
真实的表示不显示重复模式,只显示生成的表示共享的后期冲动.

blocks.en:
We compare the 36 variants with window-matched scans against the real clips of their own benchmark.
In Figure 3 , real clips sit in the lower-left corner, and most open-source and closed-source variants lie far above and to the right. Table S1 in the supplement lists every value.
The rhythm statistic of the median variant is 2.2 times that of real clips.
A threshold that only 5% of real clips exceed is exceeded by 34% of its clips.
A one-sided Mann–Whitney test with Holm correction finds a significant difference at p < 0.05 p<0.05 for 30 of the 36 variants.
The phases also separate the two classes. Figure 4 stacks the residual profiles of single clips, and generated clips form aligned bands that real clips lack.
After we remove the mean real profile, the phases of real clips are consistent with a uniform distribution, with R R near 0.08.
The median variant reaches R = 0.52 R=0.52 , as expected when the groups of every clip start at its first frame.
Gen-2 and Pika are exceptions, and their rhythm statistic is lower than that of real clips.
Jimeng, Wan (web) and two LTX variants do not reach significance with 50 clips each.

我们比较了36个变体与窗口匹配的扫描 与它们自己基准的真实剪辑。

一个只有5%真实片段超过的阈值被其片段的34%超过.
单侧Mann–Whitney测试与Holm校正在p < 0.05 p < 0.05中发现36个变体中的30个存在显著差异.
阶段还把两个班分开。 图4堆叠了单个剪辑的剩余剖面图,生成的剪辑形成真实剪辑缺乏的对齐带.

Gen-2和Pika是例外,它们的节奏统计低于真实的剪辑.
Jimeng),Wan(web)和两个LTX变体都没有意义,每个都有50个片段.

blocks.en:
Section S1 in the supplement collects our tests of the origin and limits of the rhythm.
A VAE round trip induces the rhythm in real clips, whereas matched x264 re-encoding does not.
After a round trip through the Wan2.1 VAE, the period-4 score separates real clips from their reconstructions with 90% AUROC.
Real clips re-encoded with the x264 settings of Grok stay at about 49%.
Removing two leading frames shifts its phase by two positions.
The rhythm weakens in nearly static clips and when the scan resolution is far below the generation resolution.
For real clips reconstructed by a VAE, the median period-4 score falls from 0.64 to 0.33 when the scan resolution drops to about half the reconstruction resolution.
Scanning at native resolution instead of 256p raises the zero-shot AUROC of Sora from 72% to 90%.
We therefore scan each clip at its native resolution and downscale it only when its short side exceeds 480 pixels, a setting we call 480p.
For clips delivered with a 720-pixel short side, we also scan at that size and call this setting 720p.
blocks.zh:
副刊S1节收集了我们对节奏起源和限制的测试.
VAE的往返在真实的剪辑中诱导节奏,而匹配的x264重编码则不会.
在经过Wan2.1 VAE的往返后,4期的分数以90%的AUROC将真实的剪辑与其重建区分开来.
真实的剪辑重新编码了x264设置的Grok,停留在49%左右.
取消两个主要框架,其阶段改为两个位置。
节奏在近静态剪辑中减弱,当扫描分辨率远低于生成分辨率时.
对于由VAE重建的真片段,当扫描分辨率下降到重建分辨率的一半左右时,中位期-4得分从0.64降至0.33.
扫描原生分辨率而不是256p,将Sora的零射AUROC从72%提高到90%.
因此,我们扫描每个片段的原生分辨率, 并缩小它,只有当它的短边超过480像素, 我们称之为480p。
对于用720像素短边投递的片段,我们也用这个尺寸扫描,并称这个设置为720p.

The tests above compare groups of clips.
To check whether the rhythm also separates individual clips, we use it directly as a detection score without training, thresholds or calibration.
We scan each clip once with the frozen Wan2.1 VAE and score it with the share of residual variance at the period of its family.
This score is C 4 C_{4} by default, C 8 C_{8} for the eight-frame Kling 3.0 and LTX 2.3 T2V, and P pk P_{\mathrm{pk}} for the period-5 Wan 2.6.
We measure its AUROC against the real clips of the same benchmark, where 50% is chance.

上述测试比较了片段的组别.
为了检查节奏是否也分离了单个片段,我们直接将其作为检测分数,而不经过训练,阈值或校准.
我们用冰冻的Wan2.1 VAE扫描每段片段一次,并用其家族时期的剩余差异份额来评分.
此分数默认为C 4 C_{4},C 8 C_{8}为八阵型Kling 3.0和LTX 2.3 T2V,Pk P_{\mathrm{pk}} 5 Wan 2.6.

blocks.en:
Table 1 shows representative results, and Table S2 in the supplement lists all variants.
The score exceeds chance on 34 of the 36 window-matched variants.
As the mechanism predicts, it is strongest on open-source generators with a 4 × 4\times VAE.
It also works on closed-source models with unknown VAEs, such as Sora and Kling 3.0.
It is weaker on the 8 × 8\times LTX family, because our 4 × 4\times measurement VAE does not match it.
Most DF26 and 2026 generators improve at 720p, which is consistent with the scale dependence.
Gen-2 and Pika stay below chance, which matches their flat curves.
With the single statistic P pk P_{\mathrm{pk}} for all generators, the score reaches 76.2% on DF26’s ten generators.
The best retrained baseline on DF26 is Effort, and the score exceeds it by 5.8%.
Supervised detectors train on AIGVDBench’s own Open-Sora clips, so on AIGVDBench the score trails most of them.

blocks.en:
Section 3 shows that VAE decoding causes the rhythm and that an off-the-shelf VAE measures it across generators.
We therefore build on a frozen VAE and real videos rather than on any particular generator. Figure 5 summarizes the method.

因此,我们利用一个冻结的VAE和真实的视频,而不是任何特定的生成器。 图5总结了这一方法。

The controls of Section 3.2 show that a VAE round trip alone induces the rhythm in real clips.
Sampling generators is costly and often impossible for closed models, so we create training data by passing real clips through a frozen VAE.

Many benchmarks confound generation with format and metadata [ 23 , 7 ] .

blocks.en: 4.2 CaDet: two paths on one frozen backbone
blocks.zh: 4.2 CaDet:一个冷冻骨干上的两条路径

blocks.en: Table 2 : Main results (AUROC, %). All detectors are trained on AIGVDBench’s Open-Sora and real clips and tested without retraining. ± \pm is the standard deviation over 3 seeds, and bold marks the best per column.
blocks.zh: 表2:主要结果(非洲区域办事处,%)。 所有探测器都经过AIGVDBench的Open-Sora和真实的剪辑的培训,并且未经再培训而测试. ±\pm是3个种子上的标准偏差,粗体标记为每列最佳.

blocks.en:
Decoding traces may weaken or change when a closed-source generator uses an unknown VAE and post-processing, so cues that do not depend on the VAE are also needed. Section 5.4 shows that one model does not easily learn both, because adding the VAE pairs to Effort [ 98 ] hurts it on closed-source generators.
CaDet therefore attaches two paths to one frozen DINOv3 ViT-L/16 [ 68 ] .
The artifact path learns decoding traces from the pairs, and the semantic path never sees them.
Freezing the backbone keeps its pretrained features and is meant to limit overfitting.
Both paths share the frozen weights, so CaDet stores one backbone and two small trainable parts.
blocks.zh:
当一个闭源生成器使用未知的VAE和后处理时,解码痕迹可能会削弱或改变,所以也需要不依赖于VAE的提示. 第5.4节显示,一种模型不容易同时学习,因为将VAE对子添加到Effort [98] 在闭源发电机上伤害它.
因此,CaDet将两条路连接到一条冻结的DINov3 VIT-L/16 [68].
文物路径从对子中学习解码痕迹,语义路径从不看到.
冻结骨干保持其预先训练的特性,意在限制过度配制.
两条路径都共享冷冻重量,因此CaDet储存了1个骨干和2个小的可列车部件.

blocks.en:
LoRA [ 29 ] adapters on the attention projections feed two heads.
The generic head reads the final class token and is trained with counterfactual labels.
Both members of every pair count as real, and only generator-produced clips count as generated. Section S3 in the supplement shows that VAE reconstructions are smoother and less noisy than their sources.
A head that calls them generated may learn that smoothness means generation and then miss sharp closed-source videos.
The counterfactual labels make this appearance useless to the generic head.
The artifact head reads class-token and patch-token statistics of intermediate layers because we expect these layers to keep more low-level detail.
It keeps the original labels to learn the decoding traces, and its gradient also updates the shared adapters.
The path score sums the two head scores after standardizing each on real videos. Table S5 in the supplement supports the two heads and the shared gradient.
blocks.zh:
LoRA [29] 注意力预测的适配器为两个头.
通用头部读取最终的类符号,并接受反事实标签的培训.
每个配对的两名成员都算为真实,只有发电机制作的片段算为生成. 副刊第S3节显示,VAE重建比其来源更平滑,也不太吵.
一个称他们为生成者的头可能知道光滑意味着生成,然后错过锐利的闭源视频.
反事实标签使得这种外观对一般头部毫无用处.
文物头部读取了中间层的类-托肯和补丁-托肯统计,因为我们期望这些层能保持更低级的细节.
它保留了原始的标签来学习解码痕迹,它的梯度也更新了共享的适配器.
路径得分将两个头的得分在真实视频上分别标准化后进行汇总. 补编中的表S5支持两个头和共享梯度.

blocks.en:
Following Effort [ 98 ] , this path freezes the principal singular subspace of every attention matrix and trains only the smallest singular component and a linear head.
Effort argues that the frozen subspace preserves pretrained knowledge and that the small trainable part limits overfitting.
The path trains frame by frame, and a clip’s score is the logit of its mean frame probability.
blocks.zh:
在Effect [98] 之后,这条路径冻结了每个关注矩阵的主单数子空间,列车只有最小的单数组件和一个线性头.
Effort认为,被冻结的子空间保留了事先训练过的知识,小可训练的部分限制了过度适应.
路径列车框架按帧,一个剪辑的分数是其平均帧概率的对数.

blocks.en:
At test time, we standardize the score of each path by its mean and standard deviation on held-out real clips and sum the two to obtain s d s_{d} .
Both terms then count standard deviations above typical real videos, so we add them without fitting any weight on generated videos.
CaDet-GF trains only on real videos and their pairs.
The generic head and the semantic path would then lack generated examples.
CaDet-GF is therefore a single LoRA path with one linear head and the original labels, and it selects checkpoints on held-out pairs.
blocks.zh:
在测试时,我们用每条路径的中间偏差和标准偏差来规范每条路径的得分,然后将两者相加,以获得s d s_{d}。
两个词都计算出标准偏差,
CaDet-GF列车只使用真实的视频和他们的配对.
通用头和语义路径将缺乏生成的例子。
因此,CaDet-GF是一个单一的LORA路径,有一个线性头和原始的标签,它在被搁置的对上选择检查站。

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en:
We follow the one-to-all protocol of AIGVDBench [ 48 ] .
Detectors train on 14,000 Open-Sora [ 104 ] clips and 14,000 OpenVid [ 51 ] real clips and are tested on 20 open-source and 11 closed-source generators against 3,000 real clips.
We average the per-generator AUROC over open-source, unseen open-source and closed-source generators.
Without retraining, we also evaluate on DF26 [ 67 ] , which has ten generators released in 2025 and 2026 and permits content-paired 2AFC evaluation.
The 2026 models are single-shot clips of MiniMax H3, Seedance 2.5 [ 83 ] and Seedance 2.0 [ 28 ] , compared against the DF26 reals.
We also test on ViF-Bench [ 40 ] , and Section S6 in the supplement lists all test-set sizes.
All detectors use the same 8 frames from a shared 256 2 256^{2} cache, followed by method-specific input transforms.
No test clip enters detector training or the engine.
The engine uses the VAEs of Wan2.1, HunyuanVideo, CogVideoX and LTX-Video [ 82 , 36 , 100 , 26 ] .
It turns 4,000 training reals into 4,818 training and 515 validation pairs. Sections S3 and S4 in the supplement give further details.

探测器在14000个Open-Sora[104]片段和14000个OpenVid[51]真实片段上列车,并在20个开源和11个闭源发电机上对3000个真实片段进行测试.
我们平均每个源的AUROC比开源的,看不见的开源的和闭源的发电机.
在不进行再培训的情况下,我们还对DF26 [67] 进行了评估,2025年和2026年发布了10台发电机,并允许进行内容保值的2AFC评价。
2026年的车型是MiniMax H3,种子2.5[83]和种子2.0[28]的单镜头剪辑,与DF26的真车相比.
我们还在ViF-Bench [40] 测试,补充部分S6节列出了所有测试设置大小.
所有探测器都使用共享的256 2 256^{2}的缓存中相同的8帧,然后是方法特定的输入转换.
没有试验片段进入探测器训练或发动机.

We retrain the 15 baselines in Table 2 under this protocol with their official implementations, including the 2026 method Native-Scale [ 41 ] . Some reproductions remain below those results.

blocks.en: 5.2 Main results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
On AIGVDBench, CaDet reaches 93.9% AUROC on open-source and 95.8% on closed-source generators.
The strongest reproduced baselines there are ForgeLens and Effort, and CaDet exceeds them by 8.2% and 3.3%.
Without generator-produced training clips, CaDet-GF still reaches 90.9% and 91.9%.
This is well above the same backbone trained on Open-Sora without pairs, so the pairs carry most of the performance here.
CaDet also leads on the 2026 closed-source models and on all four DF26 averages.
Its DF26 all-generator AUROC of 78.5% beats Effort by 8.1%. Table S4 in the supplement reports each newer generator.
Over the four closed-source generators of DF26 and the three 2026 models, CaDet averages 83.0% and exceeds the strongest baseline TimeSformer by 2.6%.
Among the 2026 models, CaDet exceeds Effort by 17% on Seedance 2.5.
On Kling 3.0 and on the Wan 2.2 and HunyuanVideo 1.5 generators of DF26, the training-free scan alone matches or exceeds every detector in Table S4 .
All methods perform poorly on ViF-Bench because its reals are re-encoded to 256p at 16 fps.

在AIGVDBench上,CaDet在开源上达到93.9%AUROC,在闭源发电机上达到95.8%.
所复制的最强基线是ForgeLens和Effort,CaDet超过它们8.2%和3.3%。
没有发电机制作的培训剪辑,CaDet-GF仍然达到90.9%和91.9%。
这远远高于在Open-Sora上训练的同一骨干,没有配对,因此配对在此承载了大部分的性能.
CaDet还领先于2026年的闭源模型和全部四个DF26的平均值.
其DF26全传动AUROC78.5%击败Effit8.1%. 补编中的表S4报告每个更新的生成器。
在DF26和3台2026型号的4台闭源发电机上,CaDet平均为83.0%,超过最强基线TimeSformer2.6%.
在2026年的型号中,CaDet在种子2.5上超过Effort17%.

所有方法在ViF-Bench上的性能都很差,因为它的真品在16 fps时被重新编码为256p.

blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 将节奏插入19个探测器

blocks.en:

blocks.en:
On DF26, all 19 detectors improve by 6.7% to 23.7%. Figure 6 a shows where the gains come from.
Across 39 generators, the gain averaged over detectors follows the zero-shot AUROC of the rhythm with r = 0.89 r=0.89 and turns positive once that AUROC passes about 55%.
The plug-in therefore helps where a rhythm is measurable and changes little elsewhere.
This explains the smaller effect on AIGVDBench’s closed-source generators and the 2026 models, where the rhythm is weaker.
On these two groups, 13 and 18 of the 19 detectors still improve. Figure 6 b shows that weaker detectors gain more, with r = − 0.95 r=-0.95 , although even CaDet gains.
Detectors trained with VAE pairs also gain on DF26, so the temporal scan adds evidence that frame-level training misses.
On Grok Imagine, Kling 3.0 and Wan 2.6, the plug-in adds 5% to 7% to CaDet, as Table S4 in the supplement shows.
With the plug-in, CaDet remains the strongest of the 19 detectors on AIGVDBench, DF26 and the 2026 models, and it reaches 85.2% on DF26.

在39台发电机中,探测器的平均增益跟随节奏零射的AUROC(r = 0.89 r = 0.89),一旦AUROC通过约55%,就会变为正数。
因此,插件有助于在节奏可以衡量,而在其他地方变化不大的地方。
这解释了对AIGVDBench的闭源发电机和2026型号的较小影响,其中节奏较弱.
在这两组中,19个探测器中的13个和18个仍在改进。 图6b显示较弱的探测器增益更多,r = − 0.95 r =-0.95,尽管CaDet也有增益.
用 VAE 配对训练的探测器在DF26上也有增益,因此时间扫描增加了帧级训练缺失的证据.
在Grok imagine,Kling 3.0和Wan 2.6上,插件在CaDet中增加了5%至7%,如补充版的表S4所示.
有了插座,CaDet仍然是AIGVDBench,DF26和2026型机上的19个探测器中最强的,在DF26上达到了85.2%.

The signal comes from periodicity, not from the size of the reconstruction error.
If lower error is treated as generated, the error falls below chance on DF26, whereas periodicity is 34.4% higher.
Excluding the first window frame and subtracting the frame baseline both help on DF26 and the 2026 models.
As plug-in evidence, only periodicity helps.
The reconstruction error and the scores of another weak detector both lower CaDet on DF26, whereas periodicity raises it.
The positive part limits losses on AIGVDBench and the 2026 models, where the rhythm is weak.

如果较低误差作为生成处理,则该误差在DF26上低于概率,而周期则高出34.4%。

正面部分限制AIGVDBench和2026模型的损失,其中节奏弱.

blocks.en:
On one backbone, post-processed real clips alone help on closed-source generators, which suggests less reliance on processing artifacts.
Adding the VAE reconstructions raises the open-source AUROC by 19.2%.
Leaving out any one of the four VAEs keeps it between 89.1% and 93.4%, so the engine does not rely on a single VAE.
On DF26’s closed-source generators, however, the pairs lower both this backbone and Effort.
The semantic path therefore omits them, so that CaDet keeps both strengths.
blocks.zh:
在一个主干上,仅经过处理后的真实剪辑就有助于闭源发电机,这表明较少依赖加工文物.
加入VAE重建将开源AUROC提升19.2%.
撇开4个VAE中的任何1个将其保持在89.1%至93.4%之间,因此发动机不依赖一个VAE.
然而,在DF26的闭源发电机上,对子同时降低这种骨干和Effet.
因此,语义路径省略了它们,使CaDet保持了两者的长处.

blocks.en:
Figure 6 c shows that the two paths succeed on different generators.
On the 43 unseen generators, their AUROCs barely correlate, with r = 0.30 r=0.30 .
The artifact path is better on 19 of the 25 open-source generators, which fits the pairs teaching decoding artifacts.
The semantic path is better on all four closed-source models of DF26.
Their sum beats the better path on 21 of 43 generators and is never below their average.
This is not a generic ensemble effect.
The sum of the two best baselines trails CaDet in every column, and two seeds of one path keep its weakness.

25台开源发电机中19台的文物路径较好,符合对子教学解码文物.

Figure 7 applies three common kinds of processing to real and generated DF26 clips alike.
We sample 100 real clips and 15 clips of each DF26 generator and keep their first 2.5 s.
Re-compression uses x264 at CRF 23 to 38.
Downscaling reduces the short side from 720 to 540 or 360 pixels, and interpolation raises the frame rate by 1.25 or 2 times.
The rhythm score changes little at CRF 28 and stays above chance after downscaling and frame interpolation.
The plug-in therefore keeps adding evidence after processing, and it raises TimeSformer under every setting.
With the plug-in, CaDet remains the strongest detector under frame interpolation and under moderate compression or downscaling.
Under the strongest settings, it is on par with TimeSformer with the plug-in. Section S6 in the supplement gives the settings.

我们抽取了100个真实的剪辑和每台DF26发电机的15个剪辑,并保留它们的第一个2.5 s.

节奏分数在通用报告格式28中变化不大,在缩小分数和框架插值后仍高于机会。
因此,插件在处理后不断添加证据,并在每个设置下提升TimeSformer.
随着插件的插入,CaDet在帧内插和中度压缩或降级下仍然是最强的探测器.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en:
We identify VAE Rhythm as a hidden temporal signature of frame grouping in 3D causal video VAEs.
Across 39 scannable generator variants, a training-free phase scan finds it in open- and closed-source families, and controls and a scale law support its origin in decoding.
Pairs built from real videos enable generator-free detection, a semantic path makes our detector the strongest in our comparison, and the plug-in improves every tested detector on DF26.
Because the rhythm comes from decoding rather than from content, it complements detectors that learn appearance, and the plug-in adds it to them without any training.
blocks.zh:
我们确认VAE韵律是3D因果视频VAEs中帧分组的隐藏时间标志.
在39个可扫描的发电机变体中,一个无培训的相位扫描在开源和闭源的家族中找到它,控制和比例法支持它的编解码起源.
由真实视频制成的对像可以实现无发电机检测,一个语义路径使我们的检测器在比较中是最强的,插件改进了DF26上每个测试过的检测器.
因为节奏来自解码而非内容,它补充了学习外观的探测器,插件不加任何训练就添加到它们身上.

blocks.en:
Like other pixel-level traces, the rhythm needs some motion and a scan scale close to the generation scale, and strong re-encoding or frame-rate conversion can weaken it.
Future generators may also change their VAEs.
The engine needs only real videos and a VAE, so a new VAE can be added to training without collecting any generated video.
blocks.zh:
与其他像素级的痕迹一样,节奏需要一些运动和接近生成尺度的扫描尺度,强大的重编码或帧率转换可以削弱它.
未来的发电机也可以改变它们的VAE.
引擎只需要真实的视频和一个VAE,因此可以在培训中添加一个新的VAE,而无需收集任何生成的视频.

blocks.en: S1.2 Controls

blocks.en:
Four controls support the decoding origin. VAE reconstruction. Real clips passed through Wan2.1 acquire a period-4 signature. C 4 C_{4} separates the reconstructions from their originals with 90% AUROC, and the phase is aligned in all 163 clips. Temporal shift. Removing two leading frames shifts the measured phase by two positions, as the lattice predicts.
A statistic fixed to phase 0 falls to 21% AUROC, while its phase-independent counterpart stays at 67%. Codec. Some generated videos use an IBBBP coding pattern, and its four-frame interval could confound the VAE signal.
However, 120 DF26 real clips re-encoded with Grok’s x264 parameters remain indistinguishable from their originals under the scan, at about 49.0% AUROC, and their phases stay dispersed.
Re-encoding 300 AIGVDBench reals as IBBBP gives 50.2%.
HEVC B-pyramids in GenBuster reals produce a weak period-4 component at a different phase, and the 24-to-16 fps conversion of ViF-Bench produces period 2. Motion. The rhythm is weak in nearly static clips, and its measured strength increases with motion.
These controls rule out the tested codec configurations as the main explanation.

blocks.en:
Both use DINOv3 ViT-L/16 from the timm model vit_large_patch16_dinov3.lvd1689m .
LoRA on the fused query–key–value projections has rank 16, α = 32 \alpha{=}32 and dropout 0.05, which gives 1.6M trainable adapter parameters.
CaDet-GF uses one linear head with dropout 0.2 on the time-averaged final class token.
The artifact path uses the same generic head, trained with both members of each VAE pair labelled real, and an artifact head.
A measurement on 1,500 VAE pairs supports these counterfactual labels.
We measured detail as the log variance of the Laplacian and noise with Immerkær’s estimator [ 31 ] .
The reconstruction has less detail than its real counterpart in 98% of pairs and less noise in 95%.
Six other low-level statistics barely change.
The artifact head takes the class token and the patch-token mean and standard deviation of layers 8, 12 and 16, averaged over time.
These features pass through layer normalization, a 256-unit GELU layer, dropout 0.2 and a linear output, for 4.0M trainable parameters in total.
The two binary cross-entropy losses are summed with equal weights, and the gradient of the artifact head reaches the adapters.
Each head is standardized on the validation reals before the scores are summed.
We use AdamW with weight decay 0.05 and learning rates of 10 − 4 10^{-4} for the backbone adapters and 10 − 3 10^{-3} for the head.
Training runs for 8 epochs in bf16, with one warm-up epoch followed by cosine decay.
Each update uses 24 clips from batch size 8 and 3 accumulation steps.
Training augmentation uses RandomResizedCrop to 224 with scale 0.8–1 and horizontal flipping, and testing uses a center crop.
Like the baselines, the artifact path uses the final checkpoint.
CaDet-GF selects a checkpoint with held-out VAE pairs.
An artifact-path run takes about 1.5 h on an H200.

blocks.en:
We run Effort’s released DeepfakeBench [ 97 ] training code [ 98 ] unchanged except for the data lists and the backbone.
The backbone is the same DINOv3 ViT-L/16 in fp32.
In each of its 24 blocks, we split the fused query–key–value projection into three 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 matrices.
Together with the output projections, this gives 96 matrices, and Effort’s singular-value residual layers with r = 1023 r{=}1023 replace all of them.
The top 1023 singular components therefore stay frozen, and the smallest one is trained.
The replacement leaves the network unchanged at initialization, because on random inputs the class token changes by only a relative 3 × 10 − 6 3\times 10^{-6} .
All other weights are frozen.
The trainable parameters are the 96 residual components and a two-way linear head on the class token after the final normalization.
Together they have 0.20M parameters.
Frames are resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 without cropping and normalized with ImageNet statistics.
Each of the 8 frames of a training clip is an independent sample, and batches of 32 frames receive Effort’s eleven DeepfakeBench augmentations independently.
Training uses cross-entropy and Adam with learning rate 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} and weight decay 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , without a schedule or gradient clipping.
It runs in fp32 for 11 epochs, and we report the final epoch.
The score of a clip is the logit of its mean frame probability.
A run took 13–16 h on a shared H200 and 24 h on an A5000.

blocks.en:
Each pair draws its VAE at random from the 4 × 4\times VAEs of Wan2.1, HunyuanVideo and CogVideoX and the 8 × 8\times VAE of LTX-Video.
Each VAE covers 24% to 26% of pairs.
The first 4,000 pairs use each source clip once and draw the reconstruction short side G G from { 256,360,480,720 } \{256,360,480,720\} with weights 4:2:2:1.
Another 1,333 pairs reuse source clips with G = 256 G=256 for three quarters of them and G = 360 G=360 for the rest.
They also use interpolation and duplication less often, and the probabilities below describe the first 4,000 pairs.
The 515 validation pairs come from 393 source clips that no training pair uses.
Both members of a pair share one parameter vector θ \theta .
It sets a leading trim of 0, 1, 2 or 3 frames and a uniformly sampled delivery short side S ∈ { 480,720 , 1080 } S\in\{480,720,1080\} .
Motion-compensated interpolation is applied with probability 0.2 and a factor in { 1.25 , 1.5 , 2 } \{1.25,1.5,2\} .
Duplicate-frame conversion is applied with probability 0.25 and excludes interpolation.
Decimation to 16 fps is applied with probability 0.3 when applicable.
In duplication mode, both members first share a source decimated to 8–15 fps.
Only the generated member undergoes the VAE round trip, and both members are returned to 24 or 30 fps by repetition.
The encoding parameters are also shared.
The codec is x264 or x265 with equal probability, CRF is uniform in [ 18 , 28 ] [18,28] , the number of B-frames is uniform in [ 0 , 8 ] [0,8] , B-pyramid is enabled with probability 0.5, and the GOP length is uniform in [ 12,250 ] [12,250] .

blocks.en:
All baselines use the same 14,000 real and 14,000 Open-Sora training clips.
They also use the same 8 cached frames per clip at indices 0 , 4 , … , 28 0,4,\dots,28 of a 256 2 256^{2} JPEG cache at quality 95.
The five 16-frame generators are AnimateDiff-T2V [ 25 ] , SVD-I2V [ 6 ] , SEINE-I2V [ 13 ] and both VideoCrafter [ 10 ] variants, and they use frames 0 , 2 , … , 14 0,2,\dots,14 .
An earlier version of the cache repeated their last frame, and all reported results use the corrected cache except the row marked ∗ in Table S5 .
We keep method-specific augmentation, optimizers and schedules where they are compatible with the protocol.
We report the final checkpoint to avoid selection on in-domain validation scores, which are often saturated.
Official implementations are used throughout.

blocks.en:
We adapted the protocol as follows.
Effort is trained with its released DeepfakeBench code, unchanged except for the data lists.
For DeMamba, fixed frames replace random temporal starts, and batch size 128 is implemented with 32 × 4 32\times 4 gradient accumulation.
Its X-CLIP [ 52 ] vision tower is loaded from the full pretrained X-CLIP model.
For ReStraV, the common 8-frame sequence replaces the official 24-frame trajectory at 12 fps.
This gives 7 steps and 6 turning angles.
CNNSpot, Gram-Net and NPR are evaluated on full 256 2 256^{2} frames, following their official test commands.
The clip score of NPR is the logit of the mean frame probability computed in double precision, as Section S7 explains.
UnivFD uses the AIGCDetectBenchmark settings with batch size 64 and augmentation probability 0.1.
AIGVDBench defines ForgeLens setting 1 as training on a small dataset for more epochs.
We report this setting and also the same schedule on the full training set.
Both ForgeLens settings use fp32 inference to avoid tied scores from autocast.
TimeSformer and UniFormerV2 use the official MMAction2 Kinetics-400 configurations with two output classes and a 50-epoch upper limit, so the cosine phase of UniFormerV2 is compressed to 45 epochs.
Native-Scale [ 41 ] fine-tunes its Qwen2.5-VL vision encoder with the official training script and the learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} from its paper.
The released step schedule would lower this rate to 10 − 6 10^{-6} from the first step.
These changes can affect performance, especially the change in temporal sampling, and they are part of the comparison protocol.

blocks.en:
A restricted real-video source can confound generation artifacts with the appearance of that source, and audits report such confounds in existing benchmarks [ 23 , 7 ] . Table S6 tests this by swapping the real videos while the generated clips and trained detectors stay fixed.
An AUROC below 50% means that genuine videos are ranked as more synthetic than the fakes.
With Youku clips [ 93 ] as reals, all trained detectors in the table degrade sharply.
The drop is therefore a shared problem of detectors trained on one real source rather than a weakness of a particular method.
In every swapped setting, CaDet stays above Effort and above the same backbone trained without pairs.
CaDet-GF is trained only on real videos and their pairs, and it is the most robust trained detector in all three settings.
The training-free D3 [ 103 ] improves instead.
Its values come from an earlier evaluation on our frame cache, so only its change, not its values, is comparable to its paper.
All detectors in Table S7 stay near chance on ViF-Bench, and a real-source shift explains this.
Against OpenVid reals, CaDet separates the generated clips of ViF-Bench with more than 96% AUROC.
The difficulty comes from the ViF-Bench reals, which are re-encoded to 256p at 16 fps.
Because the engine needs only real videos, it can add new real sources without generator clips.
The last row is a separately trained CaDet-GF that adds 2,166 disjoint Youku clips as a second real source and broadens the processing chain.
It is evaluated with 500 clips per generator against Youku reals, and a single-head detector trained in the same way with benchmark data reaches 70.4% and 67.2%.
This costs about 3% on AIGVDBench under that protocol.

因此,这种下降是一个共同的问题,即探测器在一个真正的来源上得到训练,而不是某一特定方法的弱点。
在每个互换的设置中,CaDet都保留在Effort和Heople训练的同一骨干之上,没有配对.

blocks.en: S7 Numerical stability of score calibration
blocks.zh: S7 分数校准的数值稳定性

blocks.en:
Averaging sigmoid frame probabilities in single precision makes many NPR scores underflow to exactly zero, which ties real and generated clips.
All reported NPR results, including the plug-in, therefore use the logit of the mean frame probability computed in double precision.
This preserves the ordering of the probability mean without underflow.
For all detectors, paired 2AFC counts ties as one half, and detector heads are evaluated in fp32 to avoid quantized scores.
blocks.zh:
单精度的演绎sigmoid帧概率使得许多NPR的分数下流到完全零,这些分数将真实和生成的剪辑联系起来.
因此,所有报告的NPR结果,包括插件,都使用以双精度计算的平均帧概率的对数。
这保存了概率平均值的顺序而不下流.
对所有探测器,对2AFC计数带为一半,探测器头在fp32中被评价,以避免被量化得分.
